name: Boo Bear VR
summary: Boo Bear is a super scary and exciting horror game where you explore all kinds of different places. Each place is a level, and every level has its own tricky puzzle that you need to solve to move on. But be careful—there are creepy monsters hiding everywhere, waiting to jump out and scare you. The game makes you think hard to figure out the puzzles while also keeping an eye out for the monsters. It’s full of surprises, spooky challenges, and lots of fun.
